scientific_question: In the supplied compressible magnetohydrodynamic turbulence snapshot, consider the complete supplied three-dimensional mesh. Investigate the directional alignment between velocity and magnetic field. Use all cells, with stored cell values directly and arithmetic means of vertex values for point fields. Average the local cosine of the angle between the cell velocity and magnetic vectors. Weight cell statistics by cell volume and normalize by the included volume. Report the signed alignment coefficient.
